paper_title: Axion and neutrino bounds improved with new calibrations of the tip of the red-giant branch using geometric distance determinations
notes: Stellar cooling bound from tip of the red-giant branch (TRGB) with new geometric distance calibrations. Best (galactic) bound from omega Centauri: g_ae < 1.3e-13 at 95% CL (68% CL: 0.64e-13). Cleanest extragalactic case NGC 4258 gives g_ae < 1.6e-13 (95% CL). Bound is mass-independent for axions light enough to be emitted from red-giant cores (m_a well below the core temperature ~10 keV); no explicit mass validity range stated, so encoded with mass=0 sentinel. Paper also constrains neutrino magnetic dipole moment mu_nu < 1.2e-12 mu_B (not encoded). Not a dark-matter search, so no local DM density assumption. | selector: text (sole candidate)
